title: Q: What are some common pitfalls to avoid when writing expository dialogue?
use_cases: Use when drafting dialogue to identify and remove inorganic exposition
Implement when reviewing scripts for 'info dumping' or contrived plot explanations
Configure when training creative writers on narrative balance techniques
Use when analyzing character interactions to ensure natural speech patterns
content:
A: Common pitfalls include info dumping, using exposition as a way to explain complex plot points or backstory in a way that feels contrived or convenient, and failing to balance exposition with other narrative elements.

---
